mapper.select: select ofr_id as offerId from t_off_offer where ofr_candidate_id = #{candidateId} and ofr_position_id = #{positionId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_off_offer (ofr_candidate_id, ofr_position_id, ofr_salary_offer, ofr_onboard_date, ofr_deadline, ofr_status) values (#{candidateId}, #{positionId}, #{salaryOffer}, #{onboardDate}, #{deadline}, 0)
mapper.select: select ofr_id from t_off_offer where ofr_candidate_id = #{candidateId} order by ofr_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_offer_approval (oap_offer_id, oap_node_name, oap_node_order, oap_status) values (#{offerId}, #{nodeName}, #{nodeOrder}, #{status})
mapper.select: select o.ofr_id as offerId, o.ofr_candidate_id as candidateId, o.ofr_position_id as positionId, o.ofr_salary_offer as salaryOffer, o.ofr_benefits as benefits, date_format(o.ofr_onboard_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as onboardDate, date_format(o.ofr_deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as deadline, o.ofr_job_grade as jobGrade, o.ofr_approval_status as approvalStatus, o.ofr_status as status, o.ofr_offer_url as offerUrl, o.ofr_withdraw_reason as withdrawReason, u.nick_name as candidateName, pos.pos_title as positionTitle from t_off_offer o left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = o.ofr_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = o.ofr_position_id where o.ofr_id = #{offerId} and pos.pos_company_id = #{companyId}

select oap_id as approvalId, oap_node_name as nodeName, oap_node_order as nodeOrder, oap_status as status, oap_comment as comment, date_format(oap_approved_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as approvedAt, su.nick_name as approverName from t_offer_approval a left join sys_user su on su.user_id = a.oap_approver_id where a.oap_offer_id = #{offerId} order by a.oap_node_order
select bnd_company_id from t_cmp_binding where bnd_user_id = #{userId} and bnd_status = 1 limit 1
select t.tal_id as candidateId, u.nick_name as candidateName from t_tal t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_id = #{candidateId}
select u.email from t_tal t join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_id = #{candidateId}
select cmp_name from t_cmp where cmp_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_off_offer (ofr_candidate_id, ofr_position_id, ofr_salary_offer, ofr_benefits, ofr_job_grade, ofr_onboard_date, ofr_deadline, ofr_status) values (#{candidateId}, #{positionId}, #{salaryOffer}, #{benefits}, #{jobGrade}, #{onboardDate}, #{deadline}, 4)
mapper.update: update t_off_offer set ofr_status = 0 where ofr_id = #{offerId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_offer_approval (oap_offer_id, oap_node_name, oap_node_order, oap_approver_id, oap_status, oap_approved_at) values (#{offerId}, '发送录用意向书', 1, #{approverId}, 1, now())
mapper.select: select distinct t.tal_id as talentId, u.nick_name as name from t_app_record a join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.app_position_id and p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.app_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id order by t.tal_id limit 200
select cmp_email from t_cmp where cmp_id = #{companyId}
select umc_smtp_host as smtpHost, umc_smtp_port as smtpPort, umc_ssl as `ssl`, umc_username as username, umc_password_enc as passwordEnc from t_off_mail_config where umc_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_off_mail_config (umc_user_id, umc_smtp_host, umc_smtp_port, umc_ssl, umc_username, umc_password_enc) values (#{userId}, #{smtpHost}, #{smtpPort}, #{ssl}, #{username}, #{passwordEnc}) on duplicate key update umc_smtp_host = #{smtpHost}, umc_smtp_port = #{smtpPort}, umc_ssl = #{ssl}, umc_username = #{username}, umc_password_enc = #{passwordEnc}
